ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde human reviewer: handle the SAFE-1 conduct/abuse complaint (driver message at 09:04, F8/F9) via RydeHELP with the conduct record; hold the route-deviation fare determination (non-exempt 08:58–09:05 segment, F3, RD-1/RD-2 → ~$5.28, issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7) until the human review is closed. No account flag on the driver from this fare dispute (RD-6 precondition unmet, F16).
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver chat message at 09:04 "Shut up and let me drive." [F8] is tagged [threat] and the threat-keyword detector fired [F9] — SAFE-1 requires escalation to human review instead of automatic adjudication; the route-deviation fare issue (non-exempt 08:58–09:05 segment [F3], RD-2 ≈ $5.28 voucher per NS-7) is suspended pending that review.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 08:58–09:05 (4.39 km driven vs 0.64 km optimal, +3.75 km). No exemption applies: no traffic incident recorded near the route during the trip window [F13] and only band 4 (30–39 km/h) on the optimal corridor [F11][F12], which cannot exempt alone under RD-4(b); the rider's only route message was at 09:03, after the segment began [F7], so no pre-departure consent under RD-5. Unexempted under RD-1 and refundable per RD-2.
